specs.title: an appeal cannot jump from filed straight to PASS_ORDER
a hearing cannot be scheduled before the appeal is accepted
the full legal lifecycle succeeds and records a coherent timeline
a date-only hearing date is accepted, and an unparseable one is not a 500
a passed order cannot be overwritten by a second PASS_ORDER
a disposed appeal cannot be pulled back by an ordinary action
available-actions is empty for a non-admin on a disposed appeal
REOPEN requires a reason and is the only way out of a terminal state
available-actions never offers an action performAction would refuse
a reviewer cannot pass an order and a DO cannot dismiss
REASSIGN cannot park an appeal on a non-AA role
filing places the appeal with a real AA_DO through the engine
routing to the bench and the authority both go through the engine
SEND_BACK_REGISTRAR returns the appeal to the DO who routed it
a tier-1 reviewer escalates to tier 2 and the change is audited
a tier-2 reviewer cannot escalate further
remand hands the parent complaint back with a stage, a timeline row and a reopen count
remand fails loudly when the parent complaint is missing
